title: Amenity Type
description: A standardized open reverse-DNS string representing a physical feature, capability, or service provided by a location. Supports a 2-tier hierarchy when defining well-known values in UCP: 1) Common vocabulary for universal features that directly live on `dev.ucp.amenity` (e.g., dev.ucp.amenity.wi_fi) and 2) Industry-scoped features that MUST append their related service name on top of `dev.ucp.amenity` (e.g., dev.ucp.amenity.shopping.in_store_pickup). Businesses MAY define custom vocabulary in their own domain (e.g., com.example.amenity.auto_care_center).
